name: Kulreon for WooCommerce
author: vprodukter

sections.description:
Kulreon is for shops that sell clothing, workwear, shoes, or any product that comes in sizes. Customers see a colour × size quantity table, type how many they want of each combination, and add the whole run to the cart at once. A product with only one variation attribute gets a simple quantity list instead of a grid.

Features:

  • A colour × size (or any two-attribute) quantity table, or a one-attribute quantity list.
  • One “Add selected to cart” button for the whole run.
  • Out-of-stock and non-purchasable cells are disabled. WooCommerce stock, backorders, and per-variation minimum and maximum quantities are respected.
  • A layout that stacks by colour on a phone, with touch-friendly quantity controls.
  • Basic In / Out / Low stock labels.
  • Settings for Enable, which products or categories show the table, placement (alongside or instead of the standard variation form), and row and column attributes. Per-product overrides are available in the product editor.
  • Works with the classic cart and with Cart and Checkout blocks. Items are standard WooCommerce line items.
  • Compatible with high-performance order storage (HPOS).

It also works alongside the rest of the family, with no hard dependency on either plugin. When Tilbeon for WooCommerce is active, the two plugins will not show two grids on the same product. When Embleon for WooCommerce is active, the grid still works on its own.

Nothing is shown on the storefront until Enable is checked under WooCommerce → Kulreon.

Requirements

WordPress 6.2 or later, PHP 8.0 or later, and WooCommerce 8.2 or later. Compatible with high-performance order storage (HPOS) and with Cart and Checkout blocks.

Privacy

This plugin does not send data to any external service, does not track visitors, and does not set cookies of its own. Quantities chosen in the table are added to the WooCommerce cart like any other product.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kulreon-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin. Activation writes default settings. It does not change products or orders.
  3. Open WooCommerce → Kulreon when you are ready to configure it. Tick Enable before anything appears on the storefront.

Requires WordPress 6.2+, PHP 8.0+, and WooCommerce 8.2+.
sections.faq:
Why is nothing visible on the product page?

Tick Enable under WooCommerce → Kulreon. The size-run table then appears on variable products that have the configured attributes. You can also turn it on or off for a single product in the product editor.

Which products show the table?

Variable products, using the attributes you have set (colour × size by default, or a one-attribute quantity list). Under WooCommerce → Kulreon you can show it on all variable products, only selected products, or only selected categories.

Does it work with Cart and Checkout blocks?

Yes. The selected sizes are added as ordinary WooCommerce line items, so they appear in the classic cart and in Cart and Checkout blocks. The product-page script refreshes the mini-cart and the block cart.

What happens if I also use Tilbeon?

If Tilbeon’s own size grid is already showing on a product, Kulreon does not show a second grid there. Kulreon works as usual on every other product.

What happens if I also use Embleon?

Both plugins can be active together. The size-run table does not need Embleon.

Can I replace the usual size and colour dropdowns?

Yes. Placement can sit alongside the standard variation form or replace it.

What is removed if I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin settings are removed, unless you have chosen to keep data on uninstall. Products, orders, and the cart are left unchanged.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Security hardening: stricter nonce checks and input sanitising on the add-to-cart handlers, and escaping review.
  • Product editor styles moved to the plugin stylesheet. The WooCommerce-missing notice now appears on the Plugins screen only.

1.0.1

  • Translations are delivered by WordPress.org.
  • Internal clean-up and compatibility with Embleon 1.0.4 and Tilbeon 1.0.1.

1.0.0

  • First release: a size-run quantity table on variable products (colour × size, or a quantity list for one attribute), one-click add to cart for the whole run, a non-JS fallback, disabled out-of-stock cells, In / Out / Low stock labels, a phone layout, per-product overrides, and support for Cart and Checkout blocks and HPOS.
